purpose: Separate global bonding fraction and reservoir capacity from explicit fuel transport before interpreting the held-out 3D contrasts.
selection_provenance: Frozen after the complete 60-history discovery and 72-slot encounter map, before reading effects from the N32 holdout. The discovery N24 means at eta=10, df=1.2 were B=0.639514 (plane fast) and 0.822154 (uniform).

explicit_fuel_composition.rationale: Fixed B counts give reversible reference ensembles conditional on B population. Keep F/W present and the same reservoir geometry, molecular affinities, hop rates and same seed initial macro coordinates as the active case. The conformation fractions are prepared at time zero.
explicit_fuel_composition.comparison: Compare late active B against adjacent realized frozen fractions for the same seed and source. Report both bracket endpoints and a descriptive interpolation residual. An out-of-range B fraction is recorded as uncovered; no extrapolation or outcome-dependent new concentration.

exchange_capacity.rationale: Both geometries have total reservoir attempt capacity proportional to kex*N^2. Multiply kex by 32/24 for N32 to match nominal capacity per lattice site to N24. This matches envelope effort; actual material exchange, access and source geometry remain separately measured.
exchange_capacity.comparison: Pair N32 scaled with N32 unscaled (same complete initial state) and with N24 unscaled (same seed family, different volume), fixed T600. Preserve signed differences and all seed values.

start: Every prospective history starts at t=0 with the unstructured generator. Counts, phases, seeds and measurement windows are fixed before the new runs.
scope: Physical interpretation is conditional on the model and finite windows. Prepared conformer counts, changes in aperture capacity, and equalities from detailed balance are controls.
